About Me

Every number has a story waiting to be discovered.

My journey into data began in financial accounting, where I built a solid foundation in numbers, business operations, and financial reasoning. Working with reports every day, I realized my real interest wasn't recording numbers — it was uncovering what they meant.

That curiosity carried me into data analytics. Since then, I've used SQL, Python, Excel, and Power BI to clean data, analyze business performance, and build dashboards that answer real business questions — turning raw, messy data into insights people can act on.

I treat every dataset as a puzzle: an opportunity to find the pattern, trend, or opportunity a business can grow from. Good analysis was never about beautiful charts — it's about telling a true story with data, clearly enough that people can decide with confidence.
